messages:
maria_cs: Hey team — AtlasFleet renewal note: customer wants to shorten term to 9 months (mid-term) with seat reduce from 120 -> 90 starting on renewal. Procurement requests PO + vendor code. They also need KMS onboarding for Private deployment before signatures. Can we confirm pricing and payment terms? Attached pricing snapshot below.

jack_sales: Ok - I can offer 10% off list on the 9mo commit if they sign by EOW. That bumps committed spend down; will need CS approval on acceptance window.

maria_cs: thanks. We need legal to sign off on indemnity clause for the device telemetry use. @olivia_legal can you confirm?

olivia_legal: On it. Indemnity language is non-standard but doable. We'll need them to accept the standard Data Processing Addendum + a short amendment. Also procurement asked for `Net 30` but our finance prefers `Net 45` for this customer (new account). @tom_finance?

tom_finance: We can make Net 30 for AtlasFleet if sales accepts a 2% early pay discount or payment guarantee. Otherwise Net 45. VAT handling: they're EU-based; need VAT reverse-charge confirmation.

jack_sales: 2% early pay is acceptable to close. Confirming with customer now.

maria_cs: Quick note — Docusign is throwing a validation error for their company domain (errors out on `signerEmail` vs SSO). We're considering switching to Adobe Sign as a fallback.

deploy-bot: docusign-integration: 2025-04-12T16:02Z error=validation_error code=400

nate_se: For KMS onboarding: we'll need their key material + AAD integration. ETA 7 business days once we get the KMS access request form. I can prepare a minimal playbook.

maria_cs: I'll send KMS form + vendor code request. Can someone prep the amended SOW with the 9mo pricing + 10% discount and Net 30 + 2% early pay clause ready to route to legal?

jack_sales: I'll drop the pricing snippet here:
```
9 months | 90 seats @ $150/seat/mo list = $121,500
10% discount -> $109,350
Early pay 2% -> $107,163
```

olivia_legal: Drafting amendment. If we move to Adobe Sign we need to confirm audit trail retention; ops ok?

tom_finance: Audit trail ok. We just need a final invoice schedule and PO number. Please request PO line: `Redwood Software Inc. - 3rd party SaaS` and vendor code `RWI-0123`.

maria_cs: Customer asked about prorate for partial month when seat reduction kicks in — they want billing to start on 6/1. Can billing do prorate starting then?

tom_finance: Yes, prorate can be applied for first month. Need exact cutover date in SOW.

jack_sales: Atlas contact replied: "We accept 10% + 2% early pay. PO in progress, but legal wants indemnity text first." I'll cc legal on PO when ready.

maria_cs: Plan: I'll assemble SOW + KMS onboarding checklist + PO template. Target to send EOD tomorrow. If Docusign still fails we'll switch to Adobe Sign and tag deploy-bot for retention logs. Anything I'm missing?

nate_se: Add SSO enablement window (2 business days) and a test KMS key rotation step.

olivia_legal: Also include the data telemetry clause with redlined section attached.

jack_sales: Sounds good. I'll follow up with customer and loop when PO is in.

maria_cs: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
